annotations.title: The exact total for finishing the move (free)

description: Shows exactly what finalising this app costs: the tier for its page count (the matching data move is included), the 20% extra-app discount (never more than the app's build cost) when this account finalised another app in the last 12 months, each add-on and change switched on in nc_basket, bundles, and the total in USD, with the credit balance and whether it covers it. Nothing is charged by this tool. Credits are taken only when each part has been built and passed its automatic check, and a part that fails its check is refunded. Paying starts the full build straight away; the Cloudflare and R2 details are asked right after payment and never block it. Pages still under the pass mark get a retry round from a stronger model.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned.

job_secret.description: The job_secret returned when this job was made (or the job's signed editor link). Required with job_id when no API key is sent: the job_id alone does not open a job.

mode.description: automatic (default): every page rebuilt and deployed. developer: the briefs and the generated backend only, for the owner's own AI assistant to build the pages.
